properties.name: Nagapattinam coast: Vedaranyam swamp and Point Calimere
properties.why: Southern Cauvery delta coast in Nagapattinam district: farmland and settlements, the Great Vedaranyam Swamp, tidal mudflats and the Point Calimere wetlands. Inside the footprint of NISAR S-band track 084 A frame 007. The seaward edge follows the sand spit and the Point Calimere coast, digitised by the analyst from the 2026-10-06 HV image. Open sea is excluded because it is low-SNR and its backscatter changes with wind, not with the land surface.
